text:
You're running an engine with half the parts removed.

You read. You pick one idea. You go hard. You wait.

Nothing happens.

So you quit and call it fake.

But here's what actually happened: you took six principles that work together, picked one, and left out five.

An engine with five parts missing doesn't run. Neither do you.

The system works. Your half of it doesn't.

Start today with all six firing at once.
caption:
The system that builds empires requires all six principles firing together. Half the system gets you half the results. Send this to a man who needs it today.
#discipline #success #mindset #faith #selfimprovement
